name: io.github.christophe77/netatmo-energy-mcp
title: Netatmo Energy
description: Read-only MCP server for Netatmo thermostats and radiator valves: status, history, analytics.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Netatmo app client ID. Optional after running `npx -y netatmo-energy-mcp login`, which stores it.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Netatmo app client secret. Optional after `login`, which stores it locally.

environmentVariables.name: NETATMO_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level written to stderr: debug, info, warn, error or silent.
